    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int s;
    cin >> s;
    s -= 1; // zero-based index
    long long t;
    cin >> t;

    // Reduce s based on t
    long long mod_n = t % n;
    if (mod_n != 0) {
        if (s < m) {
            s = (s + (int)mod_n) % n;
        } else {
            s = (s - (int)mod_n) % n;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
        t -= mod_n;
    }
    t /= n;

    vector<int> seen(n, -1);
    seen[s] = 0;
    int count = 0;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        count++;
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            if (s < m) {
                s = (s + i) % n;
            } else {
                s = (s - i + n) % n;
            }
        }
        if (seen[s] != -1) {
            t %= (count - seen[s]);
        }
        seen[s] = count;
    }

    cout << s + 1 << "\n";

    return 0;
}
